item.title: Meta Patents AI Technology for Posthumous Social Media Activity
item.description: Meta, the parent company of Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, has been granted a patent for an artificial intelligence (AI) system that could keep users’ social media accounts active even after their death. The technology, described as an “SNS avatar,” uses AI to analyze a user’s past posts, comments, and interactions to simulate their online behavior. […]
